summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into note purchase agreements for a $120.0 million private offering of 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, expected to close July 31, 2026. Net proceeds will fund Phase 1 construction of its G2_Austin solar cell fab and general corporate purposes, acting as a bridge to a larger debt facility. The notes include registration rights for underlying shares. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation; the registrant is the issuer. What to watch: closing conditions and subsequent financing.
